title: 네 번째 김치찌개
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Ballad. Solo male vocals, soft and breathy in the lower register. Grand piano plays sustained chords and melodic fills. Acoustic guitar enters with light fingerpicking. Bass guitar plays sparse, melodic root notes. 72 BPM. Key of C Major. 4/4 time signature. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the vocal performance with subtle reverb on the piano and voice.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[soft grand piano chords]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
화장실 거울 앞이었어요
눈이 빨개진 채로 서 있었어요 [acoustic guitar enters, fingerpicked]
전화기가 울렸어요
엄마였어요
목소리를 먼저 다듬었어요
아직 괜찮은 척할 수 있어요
여보세요 라고 했어요
잘 지내지
